about: Shared cases for 'is this thread asking this assistant for something, and which comment is the request?'. Run against WorkFlow's Swift rules (AgentRules.swift, for Claude on the Mac) and the companion's JavaScript (for a companion). 'by' is person, self (the assistant itself), or another assistant's name. 'trigger' is the index of the comment that is the current request, or null when the thread isn't asking. A new trigger is what wakes the assistant; the same trigger again wakes nothing.
